words.gloss: having the capacity to endure and perform
to the one who is capable of doing

parts.gloss: one who is beloved or dear

words.gloss: of the nature of being assigned

literal: Other than to one who is capable of doing, having understood and having performed, a task indeed is not of the nature of being assigned thinking that 'he is a beloved person'.
translation: A task should not be entrusted to someone merely because they are a beloved associate; it must only be assigned to one who fully understands it, knows how to overcome obstacles, and has the capability to execute it.
modern: ஒரு செயலை நன்கு அறிந்து, வரும் இடையூறுகளைத் தாங்கி, அதைச் செய்து முடிக்க வல்லவரிடமே அச்செயலை ஒப்படைக்க வேண்டும்; அவர் நமக்கு நெருக்கமானவர் என்று கருதி அவரிடம் அச்செயலை ஒப்படைக்கக் கூடாது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the danger of favoritism and the necessity of competence when delegating responsibilities. The author argues that a task must only be assigned to someone who has analyzed it thoroughly, knows how to handle difficulties, and possesses the practical ability to execute it. It is a mistake to entrust a duty to someone simply because they are a close friend or beloved associate. True governance and successful action rely on choosing the right person for the job based on merit, not personal affection.
